$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: An app
description: An app XenoNet knows sessions of, and what's fixed about it, as the app registry (core/apps.js) lists it. The apps XenoNet only observes have their id, name and numbat's names only.

id.description: What its session ids begin with: <id>:<the run's id>

numbat.description: The names numbat records its runs under

products.description: Its vendor products (<vendor>/<product>), each one of the provider drift check's, which lists their sources

env.description: The environment variable that moves its folder

default.description: Its folder when the variable isn't set

elsewhere.description: Files the variable moves too, which are elsewhere when it isn't set: each file's name, and the folder it's in then

context.description: Its context window, in tokens, until a transcript says otherwise

identity.description: The kind of account it runs under, as identity/v1 has it

limits.description: Its plan limits, as live/snapshot/v1's limits name them

team.description: The developer team that signs it, codesign's TeamIdentifier

format.description: Where and how XenoNet adds its hooks: Claude Code's settings.json, Codex's hooks.json, or Grok Build's hooks folder and config.toml

events.description: The hook events XenoNet adds, in order, each with the matcher it takes, if any

unheard.description: The hook events whose answers it passes over: XenoNet tells it nothing then, and keeps its messages for an event it hears

editTools.description: For a native reader, the tools whose calls are edits

has.description: What XenoNet can do with it at most; what it can do with a session is the session's own
